title: Outstanding Young Researcher Award 2025 — AIChE SLS
text: Received an Honorable Mention in the 2025 Outstanding Young Researcher Award from the AIChE Singapore Local Section.
textZh: 获 AIChE 新加坡分会 2025 Outstanding Young Researcher Award 荣誉提名。

title: NUS Commencement 2026
text: Celebrated my PhD commencement at the National University of Singapore.
textZh: 参加新加坡国立大学 2026 年毕业典礼，纪念博士阶段的重要里程碑。

title: NUS–Tsinghua Joint Research Symposium
text: Presented our NUS–Tsinghua collaborative project, “Biomimetic Metal Cluster Catalysts for Carbon Neutrality,” on integrating atomically precise metal clusters with protein nanocages as programmable biomimetic catalytic systems.
textZh: 在 NUS–Tsinghua 联合科研研讨会上报告“面向碳中和的仿生金属团簇催化剂”合作研究，介绍原子精确团簇与蛋白纳米笼的协同构筑。

title: Runyuan Young Scholars Forum
text: Invited to present at the Runyuan Young Scholars Forum hosted by Shenzhen Technology University in Shenzhen.
textZh: 受邀参加深圳技术大学润园青年学者论坛并作学术报告。

event: 11th National Symposium on Polyoxometalate Chemistry of the Chinese Chemical Society
title: Polyoxometalate Chemistry Symposium
text: Invited speaker at the 11th National Symposium on Polyoxometalate Chemistry of the Chinese Chemical Society in Guangzhou.
textZh: 受邀参加在广州举行的中国化学会第十一届全国多酸化学学术研讨会并作邀请报告。

title: JACS Cover Article
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
text: Our work on atomic-resolved structural evolution of gold nanostructures was featured as a JACS Front Cover article.
textZh: 我们关于金纳米结构原子分辨演化的研究获选为 JACS 正封面文章。

event: Gordon Research Conference on Atomically Precise Nanochemistry
title: Gordon Research Conference
text: Presented a poster at the Gordon Research Conference on Atomically Precise Nanochemistry in Pomona, California.
textZh: 在美国加州举行的 Atomically Precise Nanochemistry Gordon Research Conference 上进行了研究海报展示。

title: JACS Accepted: Atomic-Resolved Gold Nanostructure Evolution!
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
text: Our work on tetrahedral-unit assembly in atomic-resolved gold nanostructure evolution was published in JACS.
textZh: 我们在 JACS 发表金纳米结构原子分辨演化研究，揭示由四面体结构单元主导的组装路径。

title: Advanced Materials Inside Front Cover
text: Our Perspective on ligand programming for precise surface engineering of metal nanoclusters was selected as an Advanced Materials Inside Front Cover.
textZh: 我们关于金属纳米团簇表面精确工程的观点文章获选为《Advanced Materials》内封面。

title: PhD Degree Conferred
text: Conferred the degree of Doctor of Philosophy by the National University of Singapore.
textZh: 获新加坡国立大学授予哲学博士学位。

title: Best Poster Award
text: Received the Best Poster Award at the 6th Academic Symposium on Cluster Science and Atomic Manufacturing in Ningbo, China.
textZh: 在宁波举行的第六届簇科学与原子制造学术研讨会上获最佳海报奖。

title: Doctoral Thesis Defense
text: Successfully defended my doctoral thesis at the National University of Singapore.
textZh: 在新加坡国立大学完成博士论文答辩。

title: Advanced Materials Perspective Accepted
text: Our Perspective on ligand programming for functional design of metal nanoclusters was accepted by Advanced Materials.
textZh: 我们关于金属纳米团簇配体编程与功能设计的观点文章被《Advanced Materials》接收。
